source: OpenCode Zen API + provider documentation + benchmarks

1_strict.label: Strict Privacy
1_strict.description: No data used for training. Zero-retention. No logging for improvement.

2_anonymous_improvement.label: Anonymous Improvement Only
2_anonymous_improvement.description: Data may be logged for service improvement but NOT linked to your identity. No model training.

3_model_improvement.label: Model Improvement
3_model_improvement.description: Data may be used to improve the model during the free period. Not linked to identity.

4_explicit_training.label: Explicit Training
4_explicit_training.description: Data is explicitly used to train future models. You consent to this by using the service.

opencode/mimo-v2.5-free.name: MiMo-V2.5 Free
opencode/mimo-v2.5-free.evidence: OpenCode Zen: 'During its free period, collected data may be used to improve the model.'
opencode/mimo-v2.5-free.notes: Native multimodal (text/image/video/audio). Best token efficiency — 50% fewer tokens than Muse Spark for same tasks.

opencode/nemotron-3-ultra-free.name: Nemotron 3 Ultra Free
opencode/nemotron-3-ultra-free.evidence: Trial use only. Logged for improvement but not linked to identity. NVIDIA: 'not designed to derive insights from personal data'.
opencode/nemotron-3-ultra-free.notes: 5x faster throughput than comparable models. Excellent instruction following.

opencode/nemotron-3.5-lightning-free.name: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning Free
opencode/nemotron-3.5-lightning-free.evidence: Trial use only. Logged for improvement but not linked to identity.
opencode/nemotron-3.5-lightning-free.notes: Fastest in its class. 4x output speed. Runs on consumer GPUs. 3B active params from larger model.

opencode/ling-3.0-flash-fin-free.name: Ling 3.0 Flash Fin Free
opencode/ling-3.0-flash-fin-free.evidence: OpenCode Zen: 'During its free period, collected data may be used to improve the model.'
opencode/ling-3.0-flash-fin-free.notes: Finance-focused variant. 5.1B active from 124B total params. Limited public benchmark data.

opencode/big-pickle.name: Big Pickle
opencode/big-pickle.provider: Unknown (stealth — community suspects Zhipu AI GLM-4.6)
opencode/big-pickle.evidence: OpenCode Zen: 'During its free period, collected data may be used to improve the model.' Stealth identity.
opencode/big-pickle.notes: STEALTH MODEL — identity undisclosed. Use as fallback only when other models hit rate limits. Released Oct 2025. AnyRouter reported 502 errors Aug 2026. No reliable public benchmarks found. Warns user when activated.

opencode/muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free.name: Muse Spark 1.3 Contributor Free
opencode/muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free.evidence: Prompts and completions used to train future Meta models. 95% discount in exchange for training data.
opencode/muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free.notes: 20% fewer tool calls and 25% fewer tokens than v1.2. Best long-context performance. Privacy cost: trains Meta models.

opencode/jev-1.13-free.name: JEV 1.13 Free
opencode/jev-1.13-free.notes: NOT a general-purpose LLM. Returns typed decisions (yes/no, multiple-choice, scores) with probabilities. 193x faster than frontier LLMs for structured decisions. Cannot generate text.

opencode/mimo-v2.6-flash-free.name: MiMo-V2.6 Flash Free
opencode/mimo-v2.6-flash-free.evidence: OpenCode Zen: 'During its free period, collected data may be used to improve the model.' Same Xiaomi free-period policy as MiMo-V2.5.
opencode/mimo-v2.6-flash-free.notes: Successor flash line to MiMo-V2.5 Free (appeared on Zen 2026-09-22). Public benchmarks not yet collected. Same Xiaomi free-period privacy terms as V2.5.
